title: Letters in the wind (opentype.js × simplex-noise)
description: A remix of two examples, Type particles (opentype.js) and Flow field (simplex-noise), combined by Claude Code over MCP: gusts scatter the letters into streams along a simplex-noise flow field; when the wind drops, 14,000 particles find their way back into the word, leaving trails. Hold the mouse button for wind.
description_ko: 두 예제, 글자 입자(opentype.js)와 흐름장(simplex-noise)을 Claude Code가 MCP로 섞어 만든 리믹스. 바람이 불면 글자가 simplex-noise 흐름장을 따라 흩어지고, 바람이 멎으면 14,000개의 입자가 궤적을 남기며 다시 글자로 모인다. 마우스를 누르고 있으면 바람이 분다.
prompt: Mix Type particles (opentype.js) with Flow field (simplex-noise): let the wind blow the letters apart along the flow field, then gather them back into the word.
made_with: Claude Code over MCP (Mix in): opentype.js 1.3.4 and simplex-noise 4.0.3 via ctx.utils.import
summary: Two examples mixed into one: letters dissolve into windblown streams, then gather back into words.
summary_ko: 예제 두 개를 하나로 섞었어요. 글자가 바람에 실려 물줄기처럼 흩어졌다가 다시 단어로 모여요.
try: Hold the mouse button down to make it blow
Turn off Gusts on their own and slide Wind by hand
Change Field scale for wider or tighter swirls
try_ko: 마우스 버튼을 누르고 있으면 바람이 불어요
Gusts on their own을 끄고 Wind 슬라이더를 직접 움직여 보세요
Field scale을 바꾸면 소용돌이가 넓어지거나 촘촘해져요
tool_about: This is a remix: opentype.js reads the font's letter outlines and simplex-noise makes the smooth, swirling wind. Open the two original examples to see each on its own, or press Mix in on any example to make your own.
tool_about_ko: 리믹스 예제예요. opentype.js가 폰트에서 글자 윤곽을 읽고, simplex-noise가 부드럽게 휘도는 바람을 만들어요. 원래 예제 두 개를 따로 열어 보거나, 아무 예제에서나 섞기(Mix in)를 눌러 나만의 리믹스를 만들어 보세요.

credits.source: The Bungee Project Authors (David Jonathan Ross)
